about.title: About Me
about.content: Hi, I'm a software engineer, passionate about creating solutions that truly make a difference. I leverage AI-powered tools like Cursor and GitHub Copilot to boost productivity and ship faster without compromising quality. I love projects that break the mold, ideas that challenge, and teams that dare to innovate. Naturally curious, I learn fast and enjoy turning every challenge into an opportunity to grow. For me, technology only matters if it brings people together and makes life simpler. If you're looking for someone who moves with energy, loves to think outside the box, and always keeps a smile, then we'll get along great.
about.quote: I truly believe that with passion and commitment, nothing is impossible in this field.

answers.experience: I'm a Software Engineer at Xelops Technologies (ex Neoxia Maroc) since March 2024, building full-stack web apps with React, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Docker & Azure. Before that I did multiple internships in full-stack development and test automation.
answers.tech: My main stack is React + Spring Boot + PostgreSQL. I also work with Docker, Kubernetes, Azure, Python, Flutter, and .NET. I'm always exploring new tools and frameworks!
answers.availability: I'm currently open to new opportunities! Feel free to reach out via email or LinkedIn — I'd love to chat about your project.
answers.funfact: I’m usually quite fun and cheerful (when the moment is right 😄). The photo doesn’t really show it, it’s just my only professional picture 😊
answers.ai_tools: I leverage AI-powered tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and various LLM APIs to boost productivity. I even built EasyAI Chat — a browser extension that brings GPT and Gemini to any webpage!
answers.education: I hold an engineering degree in software engineering. I'm passionate about continuous learning and always leveling up my skills through personal projects and tech communities.
